# CANDIDATE: VWAP_MEANREV_SHORT_2SIGMA

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to revert to the intraday VWAP after deviating more than two ATRs above it, especially when short-term momentum is overextended. This strategy fades extended VWAP deviations by entering short positions when price is statistically extended above VWAP with bearish momentum confirmation, targeting reversion to the mean.

## Mechanism

Entry: When SPY closes > 2 * ATR(14) above the VWAP AND RSI(14) > 60 AND volume > 1.5 * 20-bar average volume, enter a short at the close of that bar.
Exit: Chart-stop at the most recent swing high (structure invalidation); primary target at 1.5R; runner trailed with a chandelier exit (ATR * 3). Regime filters: VIX < 20, time 10:30-14:00 ET, EMA ribbon showing mixed direction (no strong alignment).
